parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
  <entity name="annotation">
    <attribute name="subject" />
    <attribute name="notetext" />
    <attribute name="filename" />
    <attribute name="annotationid" />
    <attribute name="documentbody" />
    <attribute name="mimetype" />
    <order attribute="subject" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="isdocument" operator="eq" value="1" />
      <condition attribute="mimetype" operator="in">
        <value>image/jpeg</value>
        <value>image/png</value>
      </condition>
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="new_timesheet" from="new_timesheetid" to="objectid" link-type="inner" alias="aa">
      <filter type="and">
        <condition attribute="new_invoiceid" operator="eq" uitype="new_invoice" value="@{triggerBody()?['text']}" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="new_doctemplate">
    <attribute name="new_doctemplateid" />

    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <attribute name="new_template" />
    <order attribute="new_name" descending="false" />

      <condition attribute="new_managingaccountid" operator="eq" uitype="account" value="{@{outputs('Get_a_Client_row_by_ID')?['body/accountid']}}" />

    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
